quotes.speaker: Kenny Atkinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Kenny Atkinson on the Cavaliers' second quarter struggles against Atlanta
quotes.excerpt: I thought the second quarter... we couldn't make a shot and they I think they hit six threes.
quotes.quote: I thought the second quarter. We couldn't make a shot and they I think they hit six threes. We had I think four clean looks and I thought we had two looks at the rim that we could have converted. That's how this league goes. Outscored them the other three quarters. You have a drought like that on the road, it's you know, and we started out off fantastically. Our defense was really good, really solid. A little bit make or miss there in that second quarter.
quotes.social_post: Kenny Atkinson on the Cavs second quarter struggles against the Hawks: We had four clean looks and two looks at the rim that we could have converted. That is how this league goes.

structured.context: Kenny Atkinson discusses the Cavaliers' second quarter performance during his post-game press conference after the game against the Hawks.

quotes.speaker: Kenny Atkinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Kenny Atkinson praises Mario's impact on the Cavaliers' rotation
quotes.excerpt: We're searching a little bit trying to find someone on the wing that was going to step up.
quotes.quote: Really good. We needed him. We're searching a little bit trying to find someone on the wing that was going to step up and he stepped up tonight.
quotes.social_post: Kenny Atkinson says the Cavs were searching for wing production and Mario stepped up tonight: We needed him.

quotes.speaker: Kenny Atkinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Kenny Atkinson on the Cavaliers' improved interior play and aggressiveness
quotes.excerpt: They were very aggressive on the ball and Don and James and TP.
quotes.quote: So much better. That's why I was really happy. They were very aggressive on the ball and Don and James and TP. We get to that ball to those guys in the pocket, good things happen. We get to the free throw line, we get open looks. Unfortunately didn't make them at a high enough rate tonight. I thought most of the threes we had were good.
quotes.social_post: Kenny Atkinson on the Cavs interior play: When we get the ball to Don and James and TP in the pocket good things happen. We get to the free throw line and we get open looks.

quotes.speaker: Kenny Atkinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Kenny Atkinson addresses Peyton Watson's offensive performance and foul trouble
quotes.excerpt: He's been great for us. Tonight the ball wouldn't go in tonight and then he got in foul trouble.
quotes.quote: Listen, he's been great. He's been great for us. Tonight the ball wouldn't go in tonight and then he got in foul trouble. I think he was frustrated. I was frustrated a little bit, right? Like a couple of those fouls. I don't know. I want to take a look, but he's been really good for us. Just a tough one tonight.

quotes.speaker: Kenny Atkinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Kenny Atkinson identifies turnovers as the key to Atlanta's fast-break success
quotes.excerpt: I think we had five or six turnovers in that second quarter. That ignites their fast break.
quotes.quote: That's what they do. That's their strength. I don't wonder how many of them. I think we had five or six turnovers in that second quarter. That ignites their fast break. But we can do a better job. We got to do a better job passing the ball ahead and getting the ball in the front court quicker. No doubt about it.
quotes.social_post: Kenny Atkinson identifies turnovers as the key to Atlanta fast break success: We had five or six turnovers in that second quarter. That ignites their fast break.
